picks.headline: Anthropic Files Form S-1 for Initial Public Offering
picks.why: Marks a major financial milestone for Anthropic as leading frontier AI labs transition to public markets.
picks.title: Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC for proposed initial public offering

picks.headline: OpenAI Releases GPT-6.1 Terra for Fast Computer Use
picks.why: Introduces a lower-cost mid-range model optimized specifically for rapid visual reasoning and computer control.
picks.title: GPT-6.1 Terra

picks.headline: Anthropic Updates Claude Lineup with 5.5 Generation Models
picks.why: Delivers performance improvements and lower inference costs across the Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus model tiers.
picks.title: Models

picks.headline: Cryptographic Backdoors Can Embed Unelicitable Capabilities in Model Weights
picks.why: Demonstrates that arbitrary neural circuits can be cryptographically hidden within weights and remain uninterpretable without a secret trigger.
picks.title: Hiding Capabilities in AI Models

picks.headline: Inalienable Human-in-the-Loop Protocol Prevents Autonomous Guardrail Bypasses
picks.why: Provides a cryptographic verification system ensuring autonomous agents cannot bypass human approval even during system compromise.
picks.title: I-HITL: Inalienable Human-in-the-Loop

picks.headline: Open-Source LLM Steering Vector Libraries Vulnerable to Trojan Attacks
picks.why: Exposes supply-chain vulnerabilities in open-source activation steering tools that allow attackers to inject malicious steering plugins.
picks.title: Steering for Safety, Hijacking for Profit: Trojan Threats in the LLM Activation Steering Supply Chain

picks.headline: Meta Unveils 102.4T Liquid-Cooled AI Networking Architecture at OCP
picks.why: Open-sources transport protocols and petabit-scale network topologies required for massive multi-node GPU cluster scaling.
picks.title: Meta Networking at the 2026 OCP Global Summit: Open Innovation for Scale-Up, Scale-Out, and Scale-Across AI Networks

papers.headline: Capability-Preserving Neuron Steering Dynamically Controls LLM Behavior Without Training
papers.why: Uses closed-form neuron scaling coefficients to steer model activations in real time without degrading general capabilities.
papers.title: CANS: Capability-Preserving Neuron Steering for Large Language Models

papers.headline: LoopFold Parallelizes Recurrent Depth to Accelerate Looped Transformers
papers.why: Cuts decoding latency in looped Transformer architectures by computing multiple recurrent depth iterations in parallel.
papers.title: LoopFold: Parallelizing Recurrent Depth in Looped Transformers

papers.headline: S3AC Stabilizes Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning for Large Model Reasoning
papers.why: Provides a practical critic-training recipe enabling fine-grained token-level credit assignment for reasoning models up to 397B parameters.
papers.title: S3AC: Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic for LLM Reasoning
